mapper.sql: re.id, re.event_id, re.event_type, re.user_id, su.username, su.realname, re.biz_id, re.status, re.retry_count, re.max_retry_count, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(re.result_json, '$.rewardStatus')) AS reward_status, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(re.result_json, '$.rewardValue')) AS SIGNED) AS reward_value, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(re.result_json, '$.pointsTransactionNo')) AS points_transaction_no, re.last_error_code, re.last_error_message, re.processed_at, re.created_at, re.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM reward_event re LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = re.user_id
ORDER BY re.created_at DESC, re.id DESC
SELECT , re.payload_json, re.result_json FROM reward_event re LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = re.user_id WHERE re.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN re.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN re.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN re.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN re.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN re.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_count FROM reward_event re LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = re.user_id
